Country.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/4] According to Ugandan laws, suicide or attempted suicide is still a criminal offence (Kinyanda, 2006). Therefore, all suicidal deaths must be reported to the police by relatives or community members through local leaders. Hence, our suicide subjects were identified mainly through police records and local leaders.

Type.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/4] The families or informants for each identified deceased were visited prior to the interview by a coordinator and a local leader who requested them to participate in the study and then set an appointment for the interview. All members of the deceased's family aged 18 years and above were eligible for the study. On the day of the interview, the interviewer was introduced to the family by the coordinator. A suitable place for the interview was then identified. Those individuals eligible who had consented were interviewed individually.
